deals.name: Magnolia's On The Bay
deals.deal: Bay Bar happy hour: Tue-Fri 2-5pm and Sat-Sun 12-5pm at the bar and Bay View Garden (except holidays and special events). Featured martinis $10, house wine $5 off, call cocktails/mimosas/Bloody Marys/sangria $4 off, craft drafts $3 off. Bay bites: oysters $15.90/dozen, shrimp cocktail $11.90, $10 off listed sushi rolls.

deals.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
deals.deal: Happy hour 11AM-6PM daily at the bar: order a drink, get a ticket, pull a tab for full/half price or $0.50. Weekly specials advertised; order online for takeout. Site advertises long HH hours.

deals.name: SandBar Tiki & Grille
deals.deal: Daily happy hour at the bar only, 11am-6pm, on domestic drafts, well spirits, and house wine. House wines by the glass $9. Mix-and-match bucket of 5 for $25. Takeout listed. Live music daily.

deals.name: Calico Jack's
deals.deal: Happy Hour Mon-Fri noon-5pm and Happier Hour Mon-Fri 5-7pm with all beers and cocktails 2 for 1. Sunday noon-4pm draft beer and Bloody Mary specials. Free pool all day Wednesday. Cash only.

shop.name: Publix
shop.deal: Ad week showing Oct 14-20, 2026 (some stores Oct 15-21): fall hard squash $0.99, Granny Smith apples $1.99, navel oranges $1.99, Publix chicken drumsticks $1.99/lb, thighs $2.39/lb, ground pork $3.49/lb, various BOGO items. Next week preview available.

shop.name: Winn-Dixie
shop.deal: Weekly ad around Oct 7-13, 2026 (check current flyer): chicken drumsticks or thighs value pack $1.29/lb; USDA Choice boneless bottom round or rump roast $5.99/lb; buy one get one free prime boneless pork chops and Know & Love grape tomatoes.
